FAIL_TO_PASS: side-effects-getters-and-setters: treat getters and setters as function calls
original-file-names: forwards the original file name to other hooks
side-effects-class-getters-setters: treat getters and setters on classes as function calls
object-deep-access-effect: throws when an nested property of an unknown object property is accessed
optional-chaining-null-values: supports optional chaining for null values
access-instance-prop: respects getters when accessing properties of an instance
missing-access: respects side effects when accessing missing namespace members
literal: Tree-shake known literal prototype functions
track-access-side-effect-via-destructuring: tracks property access side effects for destructured variables
parse-return-outside-function: supports parsing return statements outside functions via options
getters-on-this: handles calling getters on "this"
treeshake-import-meta: supports tree-shaking for meta properties
nested-member-access: throw an error when accessing members of null or undefined
parameter-deep-access-mutation: tracks mutations of function parameters when accessed
inlined-namespace-static-resolution: statically resolves Symbol.toStringTag for inlined namespaces
side-effects-expressions-as-statements: in order to keep certain getter calls, do not remove some expression statements
super-class-prototype-access: correctly resolves the prototype of the super class when accessing properties
known-globals: does not consider it a side-effect if a known global variable is accessed
class-method-getter-properties: respects getters added to class methods
unknown-access: respects side effects when accessing unknown namespace members
